change: Own spell-ending timers beneath ParticleFx and cancel pending timers when a battle settles or the effect node leaves its world.
finding: SceneTreeTimer objects remained alive until their original deadline after the particle world was freed. Their bound callbacks were disconnected; the old worlds and units were not kept alive by these timers.
fixture: Three sets of 100 callbacks with one-hour delays; each effect owner is freed immediately. Other checks cover normal expiry, zero delay, 2x speed, scene/world pause, round settlement, detach/reinsert, original burst parameters, replay and removed carriers.

failures: long delays leave no global timers after exit 0
long delays leave no global timers after exit 1
long delays leave no global timers after exit 2
round settlement cancels pending ending bursts
detaching a world cancels its old ending bursts

limitations: This isolates timer ownership and timing, not sustained game FPS.
The old timers eventually expire; this is retention until timeout, not proof of an unlimited leak.
The full-game Trials/co-op run uses the baseline pack while this patch is tested separately.
No Windows gameplay validation was performed for this change.
